detail.longDescription: Hey! First time poster, long time viewer (with personal user name) and early employee from a YC 2015 batch. Have the founder calling and was thinking about a world of rogue agents and human oversight/accountability. There are a few companies kind of doing this, but had the idea of bringing more actionable oversight, human approvals and recorded outcomes into the infra layer. Bigger vision is insuring against the agent slop and potential financial loses one day but... baby steps. Would love some feedback on this idea and what I've vibed the past few days and is now live. I probably overshared on the About page on the compeitive differences but what the hell, want to build in public! Any and all feedback is great. www.runledge.com - Nick
